question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Up".**

***__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence "***The radio comes on automatically at 7 o'clock to wake me (2) _________**.*" we need an appropriate preposition after '**wake me**' to be filled in the blank.
 
• ** Wake up **means to *cause someone to awaken from sleep. In this usage, a noun or pronoun can be used between **"wake"** and **"up."***
 
 
• **Example:*** ​I love to have a cup of herbal lime tea in the morning to help **wake me up.***
 
 
 
• ** ***That's why in the above-given sentence in the question and the example sentence, the pronoun **'me' **is already there which indicates that the appropriate preposition after wake me is** ''up''.**
 
• The correct answer is **option 4.**

**Correct Passage: ***The radio was already on. The radio comes on automatically at 7 o'clock to wake me **up**. I looked at the clock. (3) _______ was already ten past seven. I had to get up quickly. I went into the shower, and I could (4) _______ the news on the radio. I couldn't hear it very well, but there was a story on the news about an elephant that had (5) ________ from a local circus.*
